pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...d6 8.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight through the f1-rook and d2-pawn and said Qe2 meets ...Nxe4; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c5. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.a4
pages.notes: Plan 1 proposed a4, already played; plan 2 said ...Bb7 defends b5; plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 from a knight not on f1; plan 2 gave Black a queenside majority it lacks; plan 3 said White gets a d-file after exd5 when White's d-pawn still stands; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.c3 d5 9.d3 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the knight through the f1-rook; plan 4 played ...c5 through the c6-knight; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.c3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f3-knight via f1; plan 3 called the c1-bishop light-squared and sent it through the d2-pawn; plan 4 misdescribed the Chigorin with ...Bb7. Rewrote all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.c3 d6 9.d4
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3; plan 3 sent the queen to g4 or f3 through the knight; plan 4 was vague. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Worrall Attack, 7...O-O 8.c3 d6 9.Rd1
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave ...Nbd7 with no knight on b8. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, 6.Re1
pages.notes: Overview missed the Bxc6 and Nxe5 threat behind 6.Re1; plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 4 gave ...b4 with the pawn on b7. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.Bxc6+ bxc6 8.d4
pages.notes: Plan 2 developed the c8-bishop to a7 or b8; plan 1 repeated d4, already played, and a misrouted knight. Rewrote overview to name 6...d6 as the Averbakh, and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Averbakh, 7.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c4 with the knight on c6. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.
